notes.title: Update - New levels and characters!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

We're releasing an update that contains some improvements:
[list]
[*] Character selection
[*] 4 new levels
[*] 5 new characters inspired by streamers who supported us
[*] More references
[*] More Achievements
[*] More deaths
[*] More blood
[*] More tension
[*] More laughter
[/list]
Thanks to all who supported us!
I wish you a good game and I hope you have fun!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34996685/6400060e301781658160070c0ab858f9d96ec3a2.gif[/img]
